overall_status: NEEDS_REVIEW if any rule is FLAG or UNKNOWN; otherwise READY_FOR_REVIEW. Neither status is a coverage or binding decision.

rules.name: Required identity and effective date
rules.pass: Both values are present, valid and non-conflicting.
rules.flag: At least one value is absent.
rules.unknown: No value is absent, but at least one is invalid or conflicting.
rules.precedence: FLAG for absent values takes precedence over UNKNOWN for other unresolved values.

rules.name: Vehicle count reconciliation
rules.pass: Both are valid nonnegative integers and equal.
rules.flag: Both are valid nonnegative integers and different.
rules.unknown: Either count is absent, invalid or conflicting; or the CSV cannot be parsed.

rules.name: Operating radius
rules.pass: A valid non-conflicting radius is less than or equal to 150 miles.
rules.flag: A valid non-conflicting radius is greater than 150 miles.
rules.unknown: Radius is absent, conflicting, negative or not numeric.

rules.name: Hazardous materials
rules.pass: The explicit non-conflicting value is false or No.
rules.flag: The explicit non-conflicting value is true or Yes.
rules.unknown: Value is absent, ambiguous or conflicting.

rules.name: Loss runs attachment
rules.pass: At least one supplied readable document is explicitly a loss runs or loss history report.
rules.flag: No loss runs or loss history document is attached. A promise or statement in the email does not count.
rules.unknown: A supplied potential loss runs attachment cannot be read or its document type cannot be determined.
